notes.title: Fullscreen zoom, non-wide support and Performance Boost
notes.content:
[h2]Fullscreen Zoom[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37680794/67ec9135f389efff93810bf06d59138322952061.jpg[/img]

Some of you asked for a way to see the whole picture of the muse.
I added a small button for that.

[h2]Non-Wide support[/h2]

If you screen has a resolution on the list below, then your experience is now optimized. ːbaconahegalː

[list]
[*] 3840 x 2160
[*] 3440 x 1440
[*] 2560 x 1080
[*] 1920 x 1200
[*] 1680 x 1050
[*] 1440 x 900
[*] 1280 x 1024
[*] 1280 x 800
[*] 1024 x 768
[/list]

[h2]Performance Boost[/h2]

If you have been experiencing any lag on the game, then it's probably fixed now.

[list]
[*] Less than 2GB of VRAm
[*] Less than 8GB of RAM
[*] PC with only one CPU core.
[/list]

~(˘▾˘~)
